title: Perception
description: One substrate-agnostic world snapshot, produced by Bridge.observe(). Plain JSON — no methods on the wire (ADR-0006).

substrate.description: Which world produced this snapshot, e.g. 'null', 'melvor'.

observedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds at the moment of observation.

state.description: Substrate-defined world snapshot. Opaque at the bridge layer; any JSON. An adapter types this for its world (T2).

affordances.description: What the agent could do now — the menu the autotelic selector chooses from.

id.description: Stable identifier an Action references via its 'affordance' field.

params.description: Free-form description of the parameters this affordance accepts.
